asset.name: Tokens
asset.description: The three-layer semantic design-token system: primitive ramps for spacing, type, radius, elevation, motion, and layering; semantic roles built on them; and component tokens that are the only legal source of a rendered dimension.

rationale: The single highest-leverage foundation. Today only colour is systematized (16 semantic tokens enforced by a no-raw-hex lint) while every dimension is improvised from Tailwind's default scale, which is the mechanism behind most of the perceived polish gap.
